scope: Portable target; backend-specific implementation evidence required independently

semantics.transport: Actor mailbox user DATA enters an actor-owned Channel<T> adapter; never expose the raw inbox channel to guest code
semantics.immediate_channel: try writech returns bool, never registers a waiter, never parks a scheduler carrier
semantics.deferred_channel: nb writech returns Future<void> and may register a bounded write operation
semantics.logical_blocking_channel: writech logically suspends current task until admission; backend must fail closed rather than park a carrier if continuation lowering is unavailable
semantics.actor_try_send: Candidate compatibility API: immediate capacity result, no waiter; stale, stopped, unauthorized and invalid payload must be distinct typed errors, not capacity false.
semantics.actor_send_async: Candidate compatibility API: bounded cooperative admission receipt, with explicit typed failure; await suspends the logical context, never the carrier.
semantics.legacy_actor_send: Historical backend adapter may report MAILBOX_FULL by exception. Canonical target send(message) returns a typed admission Result<Ack, SendError> (or a Future thereof for asynchronous admission), per atto-spec chapter 05; legacy behavior is not the portable signature.
semantics.admission: Success means exactly-once mailbox admission, not handler completion or durability
semantics.ownership: Snapshot or validate payload before deferred admission; successful admission transfers ownership/quota at one linearization point; failed admission must preserve sender ownership or return the owned payload explicitly. Authorized native move/share/copy may replace wire snapshots only with equivalent semantics.
semantics.security: Never share raw guest pointers, closures or mutable sender aliases across isolation domains; CONTROL capabilities are separate from DATA
semantics.supervision: STOP, CANCEL, panic and supervisor CONTROL retain independent reserved progress under USER saturation
semantics.quiescence: Pending send cancellation before credit transfer releases waiter and quotas; cancellation after transfer cannot retract admitted mail
